This page contains all information relating to all events in the series occurring after the [[War of the Hundred Years]] up until, and including, [[Tarmon Gai'don]].

This encompasses all the events of the books, so notable historic events are also included with events that may only be known to a few, but are significant in terms of their importance to the reader. 

For information on nations existing during this period can be found under [[:Category:Nations|Nations]] and [[:Category:Former Nations of the New Era|Former Nations of the New Era]].
